text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whoa, so this is the summer training camp? Pretty sweet vibe. Atmosphere's great too. Looks like an awesome photo shoot location!
choice_data_list: Welcome to the summer camp, Gold City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Joined in halfway through, so gotta make up for lost time.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your hard work, Trainer-san! So sorry for dropping her off late, our schedule got pushed back.
choice_data_list: I’ll take care of her

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Alright, gonna drop my bags off and get changed.
choice_data_list: Let’s meet at the beach 20 minutes later!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Be back in 10 minutes? Don't underestimate how fast a pro model gets ready.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: City! Just make sure not to get a sunburn!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, I know already!
And just like that, Gold City's summer training camp began.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait, we're all cooking together today? Huh? I've never cooked before in my life! Hang on, no way, no way, no way!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: It'll be fine! Just chill. Wow, never seen you panic like this before, City. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: City-chan! Let's bring that morning energy again today!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ugh... so sleepy. Why early morning practice? Seriously, impossible...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Alright, one more lap! But this time, I'm winning!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text: ...Interesting. I won't lose. Let's bet three premium carrots on it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That's my line! You're on!
After dinner, Gold City asked to meet outside. We walked down to the beach because she wanted to talk.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...You know, I almost gave up on coming to this camp. Work kept piling up, made me wonder if I'd ever get to join.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But you worked out a schedule with me and talked to my manager. That's why I'm standing here right now.
choice_data_list: It was good!
It was good!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it was worth it. Seriously... Old me would've just sulked and complained about missing out.
choice_data_list: You’ve grown so much!
You’ve grown so much!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pfft! You're way too stiff! But... yeah. I really am grateful to you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Even jumping in halfway, I learned a ton. Got to see what the other girls are really like, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Saw plenty of sides people normally hide. Made me realize I was judging everyone just by surface appearances...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, there's a local festival coming up soon nearby. Wanna check it out? I wanna see all kinds of different faces!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's City! So pretty!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: Ah, um! I'm cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Elder Stallkeepster
text_block_list.text: Here, take one! Fresh and delicious!
Gold City's popularity was undeniable. She flashed practiced, effortless smiles to everyone calling out to her.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: City, good luck out there!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Hearing you watch my races makes me super happy.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, my face is recognized way more than I expected. Kinda wild.
choice_data_list: That’s proof that you’re working hard
That’s proof that you’re working hard

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Modeling or racing... wonder which effort they're actually looking at. Even though I really only want them to see how I run.
choice_data_list: Modelling should also contribute to the race

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way.
choice_data_list: Let’s run and check it out!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Run? Wait, you mean right now?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why do I gotta sprint through the festival grounds all the way to the end...? Seriously, what is going through your head...?!
choice_data_list: Well then, I’ll take the time
Well then, I’ll take the time

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Fine, fine, I hear you! Yeah yeah, I get it already. Let's do this. On your mark...
choice_data_list: GO!

text_block_list.text: Gold City tore across the sand in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Phew... What's the time?... Hmm, pretty much as expected.
choice_data_list: Next time, let’s run while remembering the cheering

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Don't think running it again changes anything. Whatever, here I go!
Gold City took off again, matching her previous pace.
choice_data_list: City, you can do it!
City, you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, Trainer... shout like that... But, come to think of it, back at the festival...

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: City, good luck out there!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ......Alright!
Gold City accelerated further. And then—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: GOAL...!
The result... her best recorded time across the entire training camp.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: *Pant*... *pant*... Once I heard your voice, those kids cheering flashed right into my head. And my legs just pushed forward on their own...
choice_data_list: That’s the power of the fans
That’s the power of the fans

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You're saying that power can push me even further? Then... wait, you mean...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If I can bring all those fans who only know my model side over to the racetrack—
choice_data_list: There’s no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, wow, talk about ulterior motives! You're really using the fans like that? Act all nice, but you're sneaky as hell.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Still... haha, pretty fun idea. Showing off my real running to people who only ever knew me as a pretty face.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Proving I'm not just some dress-up doll, but an incredible Umamusume!
choice_data_list: The effect of running on both paths is great
The effect of running on both paths is great

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah. I'll stick with your plan. Looks like I really do need your help to win.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So... glad to have you around, Trainer. My partner.
